frequency_question: What proportion of major financial incentive schemes proposed by sectoral ministries are successfully gazetted and implemented within their designated initial multi-year window despite inter-ministerial fiscal friction?
membership_rule: Includes central sector schemes involving direct capital outlays, interest subsidies, or credit guarantees managed by industrial or transport ministries. Excludes routine budgetary allocations or state-level schemes.

cases.name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) for Auto and Auto Components
PLI for Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery Storage
National Green Hydrogen Mission Financial Incentive Scheme

provenance_note: 6 cases named, 7 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.2x)
coverage_note: 6 named cases; believed roughly 7 in total for this specific class of heavy industry/transport financial schemes.
known_gaps: Minor variations in bureaucratic delay definitions between initial draft announcement and final gazette notification.
skeleton: Total major centrally sponsored/sectoral EV and manufacturing financial incentive schemes initiated vs those fully notified and implemented within the policy window.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 7 total tracked major industrial financial incentive proposals (accounting for one delayed/restructured scheme like the transition from FAME-II to PM E-Drive/EMPS).
validity_reason: Base rate reflects stable bureaucratic procedures and cabinet-level prioritization of green manufacturing incentives under current administrative structures, valid for the medium term.
